terms.comment: Our household word. Classically a cylinder, and a roller for levelling the ground (Cato, Vergil; Lewis & Short): the kitchen’s roller is the same tool on a small scale. Traupman’s fistula (below) is classically a pipe.
Traupman’s word; classically fistula is a pipe or tube.

phrases.latin: Massa ē frīgidāriō relāta cylindrō in orbēs tenuēs extenta est
phrases.english: Brought back from the fridge, the dough was rolled out thin with the rolling pin

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 124, 372.
